Troubleshooting · 32/50 · vfx

Clean plate missing

Failure signal

A clean plate missing condition is reported or detected during vfx.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for vfx does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Check camera reports and takes for a matching lens, move, exposure and lighting state.

Corrective action

Use an approved alternate plate or schedule a controlled reconstruction with provenance.

Prevention

Add this verification to the vfx gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
